q: The Fisher information metric g_{ij}(θ) = E[(∂ log p/∂θᵢ)(∂ log p/∂θⱼ)] is a Riemannian metric on the statistical manifold. It is important because:
opts: It is invariant under sufficient statistics (reparametrizations induced by sufficient statistics leave it invariant)
exp: The Fisher metric is the unique (up to scaling) Riemannian metric invariant under sufficient statistics (Chentsov's theorem). It is the natural intrinsic geometry on a statistical manifold.
